description: SRV-CLI-003: `-l tcp://host:port` URI form binds the given host on the given port. The case allocates a free port via `runner.defaultPortScenario="free-port"` and substitutes it into the tcp:// URI via `{port}`. Mirrors `third_party/serve/source/utilities/cli.ts:104-143` (`parseEndpoint`). Q-001 default-host/port behavior is unit-tested in `crates/irserve/src/listen_spec.rs::tests` rather than here, since exercising it would conflict with the runner's port allocation.
